title: LITMUS - Literature Informed Testbed for Mapping Usecases and Synthesizing Risk-Cards
abstract: arXiv:2611.29034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in real-world applications has heightened the need for systematic, safety-oriented deployment frameworks. Existing approaches typically prioritize the construction of datasets and risk cards around the LLM and AI architecture itself, yet they provide scant consideration for the specific use-case that drives model selection. This omission is problematic because any practical AI deployment begins with a detailed use-case description that informs the assessment of contextual hazards. In this paper, we introduce a structured pipeline that, given a use-case, automatically produces a tailored dataset and an accompanying risk card. The process ensures that identified risks are tightly coupled to the use-case, and it offers traceable evidence from peer-reviewed literature to substantiate each risk to use-case relationship. translated_title: LITMUS——基于文献的用例映射与风险卡综合测试平台
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）和人工智能（AI）在现实世界应用中的快速普及，加剧了对系统化、面向安全的部署框架的需求。现有方法通常优先围绕LLM和AI架构本身来构建数据集和风险卡，却很少考虑驱动模型选择的特定用例。这种疏漏是有问题的，因为任何实际的AI部署都始于详细的用例描述，而该描述正是评估上下文风险的基础。在本文中，我们提出了一个结构化流水线，给定一个用例，它能够自动生成定制的数据集以及配套的风险卡。该流程确保所识别的风险与用例紧密耦合，并提供来自同行评审文献的可追溯证据，以证实每一个风险与用例之间的关系。先前的声明验证方法（FActSco...
tldr: 本文提出LITMUS，一个结构化流水线，能够根据给定用例自动生成定制化数据集与风险卡，并利用同行评审文献提供可追溯证据，将每个风险与具体用例紧密关联，弥补了现有方法忽视用例场景的不足。
en_tdlr: LITMUS is a structured pipeline that automatically generates tailored datasets and risk-cards from a given use-case, providing traceable evidence from peer-reviewed literature to link each risk to its use-case.
